sentences.text: Heroin , also known as diamorphine among other names , is an opiate most commonly used as a recreational drug for its euphoric effects .	opiate	opiate	other names	Heroin#Name	recreational drug	recreational drug	euphoric	Euphoria
Medically it is occasionally used to relieve pain and in opioid replacement therapy .	relieve pain	pain medication	opioid replacement therapy	opioid replacement therapy
Heroin is typically injected , usually into a vein ; however , it can also be smoked , snorted or inhaled .	snorted	Insufflation (medicine)
Onset of effects is usually rapid and lasts for a few hours .

Common side effects include respiratory depression -LRB- decreased breathing -RRB- and about a quarter of those who use heroin become physically dependent .	respiratory depression	respiratory depression	physically dependent	physically dependent

Other side effects can include abscesses , infected heart valves , blood borne infections , constipation , and pneumonia .	abscesses	abscesses	infected heart valves	endocarditis	blood borne infections	blood borne infections	pneumonia	pneumonia
After a history of long-term use , withdrawal symptoms can begin within hours of last use .	withdrawal symptoms	opioid withdrawal
When given by injection into a vein , heroin has two to three times the effect as a similar dose of morphine .	morphine	morphine
It typically comes as a white or brown powder .
Treatment of heroin addiction often includes behavioral therapy and medications .	heroin addiction	heroin addiction	behavioral therapy	behavioral therapy
Medications used may include methadone or naltrexone .	methadone	methadone	naltrexone	naltrexone
A heroin overdose may be treated with naloxone .	naloxone	naloxone
An estimated 17 million people as of 2015 use opiates such as heroin , which together with opioids resulted in 122,000 deaths .	opioids	opioids
The total number of opiate users has increased from 1998 to 2007 after which it has remained more or less stable .	opiate	opiate
In the United States about 1.6 percent of people have used heroin at some point in time .
When people die from overdosing on a drug , the drug is usually an opioid .
Heroin was first made by C. R. Alder Wright in 1874 from morphine , a natural product of the opium poppy .	morphine	morphine	opium poppy	Papaver somniferum
Internationally , heroin is controlled under Schedules I and IV of the Single Convention on Narcotic Drugs .	Single Convention on Narcotic Drugs	Single Convention on Narcotic Drugs
It is generally illegal to make , possess , or sell heroin without a license .	illegal	Drug prohibition law	license	license
In 2015 Afghanistan produced about 66 % of the world 's opium .	Afghanistan	Afghanistan
Often heroin , which is illegally sold , is mixed with other substances such as sugar or strychnine .	strychnine	strychnine
